title: NASA Made Atoms Colder Than 1 Kelvin
hook: NASA built a place colder than nature, floating over your head.
closing: Human-built extreme cold lets researchers study matter in conditions nature cannot provide nearby.
question: What can ultracold atoms reveal?

segments.say: Empty space sits at 2.7 kelvin, far colder than a room. Only the Boomerang Nebula, the coldest natural place known, goes lower.
NASA's Cold Atom Lab chilled atoms ten billion times colder than the Boomerang Nebula. Nothing known in nature gets that cold.
The lab is 250 miles up on the space station. The Boomerang Nebula is quadrillions of miles away. Ultracold is now close.
